description: This file contains an optimized ARM AArch64 NEON assembly implementation of the quantized 8x8 general matrix multiplication (GEMM) kernel used in PyTorch's QNNPACK backend. It defines the function 'pytorch_q8gemm_ukernel_8x8__aarch64_neon' which performs fast quantized matrix multiplication leveraging ARM NEON instructions.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_ukernel_8x8__aarch64_neon
methods.description: Optimized assembly function for performing quantized 8x8 matrix multiplication on ARM AArch64 NEON architecture. It loads parameters, performs multiply-accumulate operations across multiple channels, applies requantization scaling, clamps values to min/max, and stores the resulting quantized integers.
